Details and summary elements produce readable output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<details><summary>Click to expand</summary><p>Hidden content here.</p></details>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
